mechanism.claim: When both BVOL and DVOL are already elevated, a large completed three-hour BTC trend followed by one completed opposite hour whose magnitude is no more than half the trend is a shallow inventory pullback rather than reversal; the original trend direction should relay for six hours.
mechanism.side: sign of the completed preceding three-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTPR uses implied-volatility levels and a 3h trend plus separate 1h shallow pullback. It does not use within-hour halves, opposing volatility bodies, fixed eight-hour block statistics, funding direction, or a prior candidate control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: dual implied-volatility level state plus completed multi-hour pullback geometry is absent from Gross9

clock.decision: completed UTC hour D after four consecutive valid price and volatility hours
clock.volatile_regime: BVOL close and DVOL close at D each >= own strict-prior 720h q60 with 672 observations
clock.trend: nonzero return over the three completed hours immediately before the current hour; absolute value >= strict-prior 720h q60 with 672 observations
clock.pullback: current completed-hour return is nonzero and opposite trend; absolute magnitude <= 0.5 times absolute three-hour trend
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset on exact consecutive hourly grid
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR
